Contamination Detected 🧫.problem: Contamination detected by liquid ingress in HS-50F
causes: Liquid reflux from the patient's abdomen
Level sensor malfunction or fluid detection error
repairs: Check and clean level sensor area
Ensure correct equipment height and use of filters
Contamination problem identified, recommended replace the following parts: PN 115-063725-00 - Sensor hose FRU | PN 115-076020-00 - Influent contamination FRU | PN 115-077921-00 - Gas cycle FRU
Clear contamination mark via software (V1.0 or V2.0 as per section 6.5)
Perform the flow calibration procedure as described in section 6.4.4.2 — 'KV Value Calibration for Insufflator V2.0' of the service manual
Check connectors
Reconnect IPC cable
Replace internal network board

Heating Errors 🔥.problem: Heating icon stays on even with heating pipe disconnected
causes: Damaged heating cable causing feedback to the board
LED D6 remains on even with heating cable disconnected.
repairs: Disconnect equipment from power supply
Check the heating cable and LED D6 status on heating board
If LED D6 is on without cable, replace the heating plate (PN 115-076021-00)
Reassemble unit and confirm icon is off when no cable is connected
Verify temperature reading in service menu is ~30°C without cable
If issue persists, check Main Board and Power Module
Perform functional test per service manual section 7.4.4 using heating insufflation tube (PN 115-052867-00)

Insufflator Errors 🧪.problem: Gas flow, valve or pressure sensor issue
repairs: Recalibrate sensor
Replace flow valve
Check CO2 supply and connections

Insufflation / Flow Errors 🧪.problem: Proportional valve, pressure sensor, or flow sensor issue
causes: Proportional valve out of range or short-circuited
Zero drift in high or low pressure sensor
ERR#04 to ERR#12 (flow, pressure, valve state mismatch)
repairs: Replace pneumatic module (section 9.6)
Zero calibration of pressure sensor (section 6.2)
Replace main board if sensor faults persist
Use diagnostic mode to verify valve heating or flow output
Replace fuse
Check internal power supply
Inspect power board circuitry

Image Processor / Camera Errors 🎥.problem: Video board failure or no image detected
causes: Fault in video signal output module (e.g., HDMI, DVI, SDI)
repairs: Replace CCU module
Verify camera/cable compatibility
Update firmware (check with KOL)
Use maintenance menu to reset video output settings
Check output signal ports and reconfigure resolution if needed

Camera Head Errors 🎯.problem: Camera head malfunction or improper connection
causes: Internal short-circuit or failed signal transmission
repairs: Reconnect or replace the camera head
Inspect cable integrity
Check CCU log for camera detection errors
Perform visual inspection per service manual section 5.3

Video Recording / USB Errors 💾.problem: Failure to record or store images/videos
repairs: Use Mindray-approved USB drives
Format USB to FAT32 before use
Replace recording board if detection fails (section 5.3.3)

Brightness Explosion Error 💡.problem: Excessive brightness when approaching gauze due to auto brightness function disabled
causes: Auto brightness function disabled in OSD menu
Incorrect OSD configuration not being saved after power off
repairs: Access the OSD service menu and activate the auto brightness adjustment function
If the function cannot be saved after power off, replace the video processing board (refer to section 7.3 of the service manual)
Perform image test using printed paper to verify correct brightness adjustment
Ensure all connectors (flat cable, button and side connectors) are properly connected during reassembly

causes: No power to HD3 or monitor
Wrong video input selected on monitor
repairs: Check LED indicators on HD3 and monitor
Reconnect camera head and restart HD3
Verify and replace DVI cable
Use cross-check with laptop or another HD3
If CCU failure confirmed, replace the unit

Flashing Image Error ⚡.problem: Image flickers when surgical instruments are inserted
repairs: Access OSD menu via front panel
Set AE speed to 'slow'
Switch scene mode to ENT or SDS
Select and confirm proper scene file

Color Distortion Error 🎨.problem: Inaccurate or distorted colors during procedure
causes: Incorrect settings on HD3 or monitor
repairs: Perform proper white balance with pure white object
Inspect and replace DVI or SDI cable
Reset monitor and HD3 settings to default
Select appropriate scene mode for surgery

USB Recognition Error 💾.problem: USB or portable HDD not recognized for recording
causes: USB disk not formatted in FAT32
Internal software of HDD is incompatible
repairs: Format USB/HDD to FAT32 using a PC
Use Mindray-approved or common USB models
Play recorded video using VLC or PotPlayer

Light Guide Cable Burn 🔥.problem: Patient skin burned due to overheating of light guide
causes: Broken internal optical fibers in light guide
repairs: Inspect light cable before each use
Do not use if more than 1/3 of optical fibers are broken

Light Guide Tip Damage 🛑.problem: Damage to light guide tip due to excessive insertion
causes: Limit stopper removed from light guide
repairs: Do not remove the limit stopper
Use only compatible light sources to avoid over-insertion

CAN Communication Error 🔌.problem: Loss of CAN communication between camera system and light source
repairs: Verify CAN cable is properly connected
Check CAN cable condition and port
Ensure U1 software ≥ 01.13.00.04 or R1 ≥ 01.11.00.04 for full functionality

Image Brightness Error 🌞.problem: Image too dark, too bright or with poor balance
causes: Low light source level or detection area misconfiguration
repairs: Increase AE value to brighten the image
Lower AE value to darken the image
Adjust peak ratio to reduce overexposed zones
Avoid lowering light source too much, increase brightness or adjust exposure balance

Color Balance Error 🎨.problem: Image appears with incorrect colors (e.g. purple, yellowish)
repairs: Reduce blue gain if image appears purple
Adjust red gain gradually to correct yellowish or faded image
Adjust saturation for desired color strength

Sharpness / Edge Error ✴️.problem: Image has excessive noise or unnatural borders
causes: High values for structure or edge settings
Sharpness mode set to High instead of Normal
repairs: Use 'Normal' sharpness to reduce image noise
Lower 'Structure' or 'Edge' value to avoid dark borders or color artifacts
Adjust only if necessary and monitor image impact

Fluorescence Mode Issue 🌈.problem: Weak or unclear fluorescence image during surgery
causes: Long distance or steep angle from scope to tissue
repairs: Increase fluorescence brightness (default HEP=4, GYN=2)
Bring endoscope closer or reduce the viewing angle

LCD Intermittent Display Error 💡.problem: Intermittent blackout of the LCD display during surgery or usage
causes: Loose flat cable connection between LCD and control board
Possible impact or vibration during transport
repairs: Disconnect bottom cover and inspect flat cable + LCD terminal
Replace flat cable (PN 115-076664-00 – NIR Cable Kit)
Replace LCD module (PN 115-076632-00 – Host Shell)
Replace control board (PN 115-07676800 – Control Board R1)
Ensure connectors are properly locked during reassembly
Verify serial number, date/time, and reconfigure user setup if necessary
